heading: 13.7 Cross-currency comparison
text:
### 13.7 Cross-currency comparison [LUNI.13.7]

Comparing two currency values of different dimensions is a compile error
([LUNI.8.2] cross-dimension). To compare, the author converts one side
explicitly with a rate AND a round mode, via `.to_currency(<pair>)` then
`.round(<mode>)`, before the comparison operator.

The compiler does NOT auto-insert the conversion-and-round chain for
comparisons. The truth value depends on a runtime fact (the FX rate); making
that dependency invisible at the call site would be a footgun.
